name: Dependency & Package Management
description: Dependency & Package Management standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-DEP applies.

rules.title: Pin direct dependencies and commit the canonical lockfile
rules.detail: Applications and build tooling must use a deterministic lockfile and a defined package-manager/runtime version.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Pin direct dependencies and commit the canonical lockfile.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Pin direct dependencies and commit the canonical lockfile.

rules.title: Continuously scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities
rules.detail: Use automated dependency and container/package scanning and define remediation SLA by severity and exploitability.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Continuously scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Continuously scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities.

rules.title: Minimize and justify production dependencies
rules.detail: Do not add a library for trivial functionality when maintenance, licensing, security or bundle/runtime cost exceeds the benefit.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Minimize and justify production dependencies.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Minimize and justify production dependencies.

rules.title: Review licenses for distributed software
rules.detail: Dependencies must comply with the project licensing policy; restrictive licenses require explicit approval.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Review licenses for distributed software.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Review licenses for distributed software.

rules.title: Upgrade dependencies incrementally and test compatibility
rules.detail: Prefer small, regular updates with automated tests over infrequent large jumps; major upgrades require migration review.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Upgrade dependencies incrementally and test compatibility.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Upgrade dependencies incrementally and test compatibility.

rules.title: Block untrusted install-time behavior
rules.detail: Avoid or review packages with unnecessary post-install scripts, abandoned maintainers, suspicious ownership changes or unverifiable provenance.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Block untrusted install-time behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Block untrusted install-time behavior.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-DEP applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Dependency & Package Management to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Dependency & Package Management is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Dependency & Package Management failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
